name: Leaf Dupe
author: numberz
summary: Universal small-dripleaf dupe for Spigot and older Paper
description: Bone meals an upper-half small dripleaf and re-breaks a block every cycle to duplicate it. Works on Spigot, and on Paper and forks up to 26.1.2 (Paper fixed it in 26.2); not vanilla. Normal and Grim modes, Detect sets it up. Port of numberz's AUTISM Client addon.
